In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values (uniform 0–49), bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding can cause losses if others overbid; underbidding risks losing positive-profit wins. There’s no prior history to exploit (round 1/1). Therefore, bid exactly your value: $30.0.
